name: pair-review
description: Two distinct models from one vendor review the same code, design or document blind, exchange their findings, and a fresh auditor settles each one: execution-gated, identity-blinded, evidence-graded.

interface.shortDescription: Review code and documents with two models from one vendor, then cross-examine the findings
interface.longDescription: pair-review runs two reviewers on the same target, exchanges their findings with identities hidden, and settles each finding with a fresh auditor. It produces findings.json, a scorecard and a manifest. A review run from a Codex host is a trial route in 1.1.0 (see references/hosts/codex.md); Claude Code is the primary host.
